item.title: Spain Launches International Women’s Day Campaign Ahead of Iceland Friendly
item.description: Spain women's football team is launching its 2026 International Women's Day campaign this week, adopting the slogan "Dream Without Limits." The post Spain Launches International Women’s Day Campaign Ahead of Iceland Friendly appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Cameron Brink Says Stanford Alum Fiancé Skipped DMs, Sent Email Introduction
item.description: Cameron Brink revealed fiancé Ben Felton introduced himself via email at Stanford, with the Unrivaled Basketball star getting engaged in 2024. The post Cameron Brink Says Stanford Alum Fiancé Skipped DMs, Sent Email Introduction appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Paige Bueckers Says WNBA CBA Talks “Aren’t Moving” as Strike Deadline Nears
item.description: Unrivaled Basketball star Paige Bueckers addressed the WNBA's CBA talks, saying both sides aren't moving as the March 10th deadline nears. The post Paige Bueckers Says WNBA CBA Talks “Aren’t Moving” as Strike Deadline Nears appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: TCU Shoots into Top 10 in Final Regular-Season AP Women’s College Basketball Poll
item.description: The final AP Poll of the 2025/26 NCAA women's basketball regular season saw TCU crack into the Top 10 for the first time this year. The post TCU Shoots into Top 10 in Final Regular-Season AP Women’s College Basketball Poll appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Plum, Stewart Talk WNBA Strike Ahead of March 10th CBA Deadline
item.description: WNBA players and WNBPA executive committee members discussed the possibility of a strike as the league's CBA deadline approaches. The post Plum, Stewart Talk WNBA Strike Ahead of March 10th CBA Deadline appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Top Seeds Roll in Brooklyn’s Sold-Out 2026 Unrivaled Basketball Semifinals
item.description: The 2026 Unrivaled Basketball semifinals saw No. 1 Phantom BC and No. 2 Mist BC secure their spots in Wednesday's championship game. The post Top Seeds Roll in Brooklyn’s Sold-Out 2026 Unrivaled Basketball Semifinals appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: MLV Hires Ex-NFL, USA Volleyball Exec Jaime Weston as 1st Commissioner
item.description: MLV named its first-ever commissioner this week, signing longtime sports executive Jaime Weston to lead the third-year pro volleyball league. The post MLV Hires Ex-NFL, USA Volleyball Exec Jaime Weston as 1st Commissioner appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: USA Hockey Captain Hilary Knight Says She Won Olympic Gold with a Torn MCL
item.description: USA Hockey captain Hilary Knight landed on the PWHL's injury reserves this week, as the star revealed she won Olympic gold with a torn MCL. The post USA Hockey Captain Hilary Knight Says She Won Olympic Gold with a Torn MCL appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: No. 1 Seed UCLA Leads 15-Team Big Ten Basketball Tournament Bracket
item.description: The 2026 Big Ten Basketball Tournament starts March 4th, when 15 top women's college basketball programs tip off in Indianapolis. The post No. 1 Seed UCLA Leads 15-Team Big Ten Basketball Tournament Bracket appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Barcelona Star Aitana Bonmati Earns 3rd Consecutive Laureus Award Nomination
item.description: Barcelona star Aitana Bonmati was nominated for Laureus World Sportswoman of the Year, marking her third straight nod after winning in 2024. The post Barcelona Star Aitana Bonmati Earns 3rd Consecutive Laureus Award Nomination appeared first on Just Women's Sports.
